messages:
zoe.li: Heads-up — saw a regression on prod console when panning/zooming heatmaps, charts hang for ~2s then resume. Happens after the latest client deploy.
marcus: ugh. which page? any error in console?
rashmi: @zoe.li can you repro on staging with PROD data subset? might be KV cache misses triggering huge re-renders.
zoe.li: repro steps: open /metrics, set timeframe 90d, click heatmap brush -> stall. No obvious console error, but network shows several /api/metrics/chunk requests queued.
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: frontend@v2026.3.18-ff3c (canary -> service=console) by ryan at 1908765429
ryan: looks like the canary included the new chunked-sourcemap lookup for devtools mapping. I didn't think it touched runtime path but it ships a synchronous map parser.
ella: that parser walks sourcemap index and does a bunch of JSON.parse on large files — could block main thread. We shipped it for better stack traces in telemetry.
marcus: If it's sync on viewport interactions that's bad. Can we lazy-init it behind user gesture or offload to worker?
rashmi: quick telemetry check: spikes in Main thread CPU correlate with slow chart events. Also breadcrumbs show "sourcemap:lookup:start" right before stall.
zoe.li: attaching packed webpack report snippet: ```
  Asset                                Size   Chunks             Chunk Names
  main.1a2b3c.js                      1.6 MB       0  [emitted]  main
  vendor.9f8e7d.js                   2.1 MB       1  [emitted]  vendor
  sourcemap-index.worker.js          420 KB       2  [emitted]  worker
  sourcemap-lookup-sync.js           360 KB       3  [emitted]  lookup
```
ryan: that lookup bundle got included in main because of an import in telemetry/utils. My bad. We should code-split it and load as worker.
ella: hotfix idea: dynamically import the lookup module in telemetry only when a stacktrace is expanded, and keep a fallback that returns unmapped frames.
marcus: Can we revert the telemetry change for the canary and push a quick patch? Or toggle a feature flag?
rashmi: We have a rollout flag (telemetry_sourcemap_lookup). It defaults true for canary. I can flip to false for all canary groups now — will reduce main payload and stop sync work.
zoe.li: flipping flag now would be safest to restore UX quickly. If we still need mapping for error pages, use worker + streaming parse.
ryan: I'm on it. Reverting import and opening a PR for worker offload + lazy init. Also adding a perf test to our e2e harness to simulate heavy brush events.
marcus: after flag flip, let's monitor charts p95 and bundle size. Add a short-term DSAT for any remaining regressions.
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: telemetry_sourcemap_lookup=false for group=canary by rashmi at 1908765441
ella: after flag flip I still saw ~100ms blips on initial paint due to leftover map registration — will follow up with small patch to move registration into worker bootstrap.
rashmi: monitoring dashboards: charts latency p95 dropped from 1.9s -> 220ms in the canary cohort. Confirming metrics across regions. :tada:
zoe.li: nice. let's keep this in canary for 24h then ship revert to stable if clean. Thanks everyone for fast triage. :pray:
ryan: lesson: internal APIs that touch sourcemaps must be worker-friendly and code-splited. will add lint rule to prevent direct import into main entry.
marcus: check also our bundle analyzer CI job — it should fail if main grows > 200kb next time.
ella: opened issue #1024 with proposed worker refactor and perf test notes.
zoe.li: closing loop — will post a short postmortem in #postmortems if stable after canary window.
